Overview of Daegu Region (Daegu)

Daegu Region (Daegu) is located in the Daegu region of South Korea, with its prefectural capital at Daegu. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Historic cultural district, Traditional market (Sijang), Mountain & river parks, Local museum & heritage trail.

RegionDaegu
Capital cityDaegu
Cities & municipalities36
Primary transport hubDaegu Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Daegu Region

Connected via KORAIL KTX / SRT high-speed rail, Express Bus terminals, and T-money nationwide transit card. Use our KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Daegu

When visiting cities across Daegu, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Korean BBQ (Samgyeopsal & Hanwoo)
  • Bibimbap
  • Kimchi jjigae
  • Tteokbokki & street food
  • Local makgeolli

Best time to visit Daegu

Best time to visit Daegu: Apr–May, Sep–Nov.
